note: Views Entity Embed embeds Views in CKEditor via the Embed/Entity Embed framework. It provides an embed_views EmbedType, a views_embed text filter (title 'Display embedded views') that renders <drupal-views data-view-name data-view-display data-view-arguments> tags, and installs an embed button (config embed.button.views, type_id embed_views). An embed button's type_settings can restrict views (filter_views/views_options) and displays (filter_displays/display_options). No settings page, permissions, Drush, or config schema of its own. Medium/hard cases create/inspect namespaced vee_* embed_button entities and vee_* text formats via drush; verify checks embed_button type_id or the format's views_embed filter + allowed <drupal-views> tag.

evals.prompt: With the Views Entity Embed Drupal module, what HTML element is placed in the text to embed a view, which two data-attributes on it are required, and which text filter renders it?
evals.expected_output: A <drupal-views> element carrying data-view-name and data-view-display (optionally data-view-arguments). The 'Display embedded views' filter (id views_embed) finds and renders those tags.

evals.prompt: How do I set up Views Entity Embed on a text format so editors can embed views? Mention the filter, the allowed-HTML requirement, and the embed button.
evals.expected_output: Enable the Display embedded views (views_embed) filter on the format; if Limit allowed HTML tags is on, allow the <drupal-views> tag with its data-view-* attributes; and create/place an embed button of type Views (embed_views) in the CKEditor toolbar.

evals.prompt: In Views Entity Embed, what is the machine id of the embed type used for the embed button, and what can that button optionally restrict?
evals.expected_output: The embed type id is embed_views. A button of that type can optionally restrict which Views are allowed (filter_views/views_options) and which display plugins are allowed (filter_displays/display_options); leaving them off allows all.

evals.prompt: On this site there is a Views Entity Embed embed button with id vee_known that has been restricted to allow only one View. Inspect the live embed button configuration and state which View id it is limited to.
evals.expected_output: It is restricted to the 'content' View: embed.button.vee_known has type_id embed_views with type_settings.filter_views: 1 and type_settings.views_options containing content.

evals.prompt: A text format on this site has been configured so that embedded views will render. Inspect the live filter configuration and give the machine name (format id) of the format that has the Views Entity Embed 'Display embedded views' filter enabled.
evals.expected_output: The format is vee_fmt: filter.format.vee_fmt has filters.views_embed.status: true.

evals.prompt: On this site, using Views Entity Embed, create an embed button with id vee_btn whose embed type is Views (embed_views), so editors can embed views. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: An embed_button config entity vee_btn exists with type_id embed_views.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a text format with machine id vee_embed that can render embedded views: enable the 'Display embedded views' (views_embed) filter, and enable Limit allowed HTML tags with an allowed-HTML list that permits the <drupal-views> tag (with data-view-name and data-view-display). Save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: filter.format.vee_embed has filters.views_embed.status: true and its filter_html allowed_html contains a <drupal-views ...> tag entry.
